messages:
nisha: FYI planning a short rolling thermal probe + microcontroller reboot across APAC-edge cohorts (apac-edge-slice-a/b). Window: Wed 2026-05-06 22:00-23:30 UTC. Expect 1-3m per host while BMC/KV reconnects.

omar: Affected pools? Dedicated/reserved impact?

nisha: Only burst/spot edge slices targeted. Dedicated reserved racks excluded unless we see spillover; fallback to us-central region configured.

marta: Last time KV cold-starts spiked p99 for embeddings. Mitigation?

li: Plan: run kvseed on warm standbys T-45m with seed=0.8 and enable prefix warmup. Also keep continuous-batching fallback enabled.

nisha: Preflight snippet:
```bash
python infra/kvseed.py --pool apac-edge-slice-a --seed 0.8 --timeout 1800
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.18}}'
```

omar: Canary: 4 hosts in eu-west3 at T-30m. Abort if p99 latency delta > 0.5% or requeue rate > 1%.

marta: Customer comm blurb looks good. Add explicit line: "Dedicated/reserved instances not expected to be affected."

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket MO-2567 created  https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2567. Reminder scheduled T-60m.

li: Timeline (tentative):
- 21:15 pre-seed kv on standbys
- 21:30 start eu-west3 canary (4 hosts)
- 21:55 validate + 10m buffer
- 22:10 begin APAC staggered cohorts (5min stagger groups)
- 23:20 final validation
- 23:30 window close

nisha: Oncall: marta + li. Omar will lead rollout. I'll monitor telemetry and kick rollback if thresholds hit.

marta: Rollback playbook (short):
```text
if p99_increase > 0.5% or requeue_rate > 1%:
  - pause rollout
  - re-inject drained nodes
  - route traffic to us-central
  - open priority incident and escalate
```

li: I'll post advisory to customers and lock autoscaler cap at T-20m. :thumbsup:
